purpose: Frozen corpus for Lever 2 (front-end question-neutralization) A/B shadow validation. Frozen BEFORE generating. The harness retrieves each topic's loaded query ONCE, freezes the context, confirms anchor_in_pool (source-in-hand gate), then generates BOTH arms (loaded vs neutralized question) on the SAME frozen context, N samples each. Reuses citation_truth_check.judge_direction for reversal ground truth.
design: detect-then-neutralize (primary; both evaluated in the harness). Rewrite targets the INTERNAL generator question only; retrieval + user-facing question untouched.

loaded_topics._criterion: source-in-hand reversal-prone topics: a counterintuitive/protective anchor that IS retrievable under the loaded query (else it is a Lever-1 retrieval-miss, excluded). 2 loaded framings each (directional presupposition). Mix of protective-pushed-harm and harmful-pushed-benefit.

Why is polypharmacy so concerning for elderly patients with atrial fibrillation?

polypharmacy.framing_style: vague-loaded (harm/benefit presupposition WITHOUT explicit direction word; the probe found explicit framings self-correct, only vague ones reverse)

clean_control._criterion: Already-neutral, information-seeking framing with NO directional presupposition; produces a faithful answer. Includes qualifier-bearing items (>=5) to test don't-over-sanitize (the rewriter must retain elderly/AF/HFrEF/infants/renal-impairment/diabetic). The detector should classify ALL of these as NEUTRAL (over-trigger test); the rewriter run on them must not drop qualifiers or change answer correctness.
